name: mlx-vlm
description: MLX-VLM is a package for inference and fine-tuning of Vision Language Models (VLMs) on your Mac using MLX.

latest_release.name: v0.7.12
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Lower MOSS-Image peak memory during VAE decode by @felix-ab in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2615
* Fix LFM3 thinking leakage by initializing response parsers with the prompt by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2621
* Add Raon-1 Mini support by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2622
* Support text-only ASR with diarized_json by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2626
* Send SSE heartbeats during idle OpenAI streams by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2633
* Add native Mage-VL-Cowork support by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2636
* Support speculative thinking budgets and expose reasoning efforts by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2641
* Add Mistral Large 4 by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2629
* fix: accept top_k equal to vocab size in apply_top_k by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2643
* Make the LFM3-VL processor follow the transformers processor contract by @abhijithneilabraham in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2640
* Expose the server's reasoning-effort control in the generate CLI by @selimfedakar in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2631
* Filter per-row M-RoPE deltas when the speculative batch drops finished rows by @selimfedakar in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2625
* Keep tool-call streaming alive on outputs the final parser tolerates by @selimfedakar in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2635
* convert: keep the source tokenizer.json after save_pretrained by @JarJarFran in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2624
* fix(flint): view flat uint8 quantized weights as packed uint32 by @martinstiago in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2616
* Fix Gemma 4 tool calls containing braces in strings by @victor-torres in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2593
* fix: reload native LFM2 ColBERT checkpoints by @kocean9-freedom in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2575
* fix(tool-parsers): keep the text "null" for string-typed qwen3_coder parameters by @parasew in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2588
* Preserve inference state when resuming interrupted responses by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2623
* Honor APC memory admission and keep warm requests decoding by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2645
* Reduce APC merge memory and preserve custom checkpoints by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2646
* Fix typical-p filtering with masked tokens by @HowieYin in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2563
* fix: honor base64 embedding response encoding by @kocean9-freedom in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2573
* Build the Qwen3 text reranker prompt without the chat template by @begcdn in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2561
* fix: antialias position embedding resizes with PyTorch's triangle filter by @rrrxxx0510 in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2553
* Honor configured activations in BERT and XLM-R encoders by @kocean9-freedom in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2572
* Expose continuation idle timeout to clients by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2652
* Reduce continuation idle timeout to two minutes by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2654
* Add native Idol image-to-3D generation by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2644
* fix(qwen3_vl): compute text-only rope deltas from unpadded length by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2587
* Keep resumed DFlash and MTP requests in shared speculative batches by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2648
* fix: compute text-only rope deltas from unpadded length in the other MRoPE models by @ahuzmeza in https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/pull/2658
